title: Options: index setup + one bounded adjustment
description: An index-ticker technical setup selects a defined option structure from live premiums/Greeks. Both legs are frozen explicitly before submission.

underlying.description: Index ticker the option chain belongs to (for example NIFTY or BANKNIFTY).

index_ticker.description: Catalog coordinate of the index whose candles drive the setup (for example NSE:NIFTY50). Defaults to the underlying plus its exchange.

interval.description: Candle interval for the index-ticker setup.

rsi_period.description: RSI period over the index candles.

bullish_rsi_level.description: RSI at or above which the bullish call-spread setup is considered confirmed.

long_offset_points.description: Points from spot for the LONG call leg (0 = at the money).

short_offset_points.description: Points from spot for the SHORT call leg of the entry spread.

product.description: Frozen product for the option legs.

expiry_policy.description: Frozen expiry policy. Physical settlement needs separate capability evidence and is not offered here.

deadline_seconds.description: How long the child waits for an owner decision on an approval-based request.

hold_after_entry.description: Finish this evaluation once its own entry has executed, leaving the structure HELD for a LATER supervised evaluation to close. This is the restart shape: a finite child is disposable, its structure is not.

duplicate_entry_probe.description: Once, ask the platform whether a SECOND entry for the structure this strategy already holds would be admitted, and report the answer. The probe submits no order and is skipped when the freshly frozen legs are not the held structure.
